independent_verifier_adversarial_checks: 1. SPD Metric Check: validate_gram_metric_spd(chart_metric) must pass.

2. Distinct Non-Collinear Triangle & Incidence Topology Check: derived_right_triangle = [V_right, V_adj, V_opp] must have 3 distinct points with non-zero Gram area; hypotenuse endpoints must equal {V_adj, V_opp} (must NOT contain V_right); adjacent_leg endpoints must equal {V_right, V_adj} (MUST contain BOTH V_right AND angle_witness.vertex); opposite_leg endpoints must equal {V_right, V_opp} (MUST contain V_right and EXCLUDE angle_witness.vertex). This catches leg swapping even at 45° where numeric leg lengths coincide.

3. Deductive + Metric Right-Angle Check: perpendicularity_justification.supporting_calls must exist in calls and deductively entail orthogonality at V_right (right_angle, perpendicular_lines, perpendicular_line_plane, orthogonal_projection, orthogonal_projection_line, right prism lateral edge, or rhombus diagonal intersection), AND exact <V_adj - V_right, V_opp - V_right>_G == 0.

4. Deductive + Metric Angle/Ratio Witness Check: angle_witness must match the cited source angle/equal_length/segment_ratio premise call (including exact foot projection ray for line_plane_angle and edge-orthogonal rays for dihedral_angle/plane_plane_angle), satisfy 0 < sin_sq < 1, 0 < cos_sq < 1, sin_sq + cos_sq == 1, <r1, r2>_G > 0 (strictly acute), and <r1, r2>_G^2 == cos_sq * <r1, r1>_G * <r2, r2>_G.

5. Exact Symbolic Formula Re-Evaluation Check: independently recomputes target length^2 and exact Radical from known_inputs according to trig_identity (verifying known_inputs were genuinely independent inputs and not circularly equal to the derived output), and requires exact match with exact_length_expr, scene segment Gram length^2, and dimension == 'LENGTH'. Rejects any mutated witness, swapped leg/hypotenuse, forged trig_identity, or tampered expression with TrigCertificateError -> RESULT_BINDING_UNVERIFIED.
